PancakeSwap operates as a decentralized exchange built on the BNB Smart Chain. PancakeSwap uses an automated market maker model that relies on liquidity pools rather than an order book. PancakeSwap uses its native token CAKE for governance and rewards.

Bomb Crypto is a blockchain-based game that runs on the Binance Smart Chain. Bomb Crypto uses non-fungible tokens to represent in-game heroes and items. Bomb Crypto follows a play-to-earn model in which players can earn tokens through gameplay.
